actual_provenance: Ported original source38, whose parent marks.rs exactly equals this approved base. Inspected original/current mark code and pinned Tiptoe marks/line/curve/utility/license sources. No Tiptoe source was downloaded into or vendored with the package.

replacement_constructions.triangle_stealth: Generic offset-line intersections/corner bisectors and edge-direction tests replace Tiptoe trigonometric x1/x2/x3 special cases.
replacement_constructions.straight: Tangent from the tip to round endpoint caps replaces old fixed-angle inset.
replacement_constructions.round_tikz: Inner-box dart and two Kurbo quarter arcs replace old L-thickness special case and 0.42/0.32/0.1 control points.
replacement_constructions.barb_hooks_circle: Kurbo Arc/Ellipse geometry from local centre/radius definitions and stroke growth; no Tiptoe path/arc renderer retained. Elementary shape meaning and public arc fields remain.
replacement_constructions.bar_bracket_square_diamond: Local symmetric lines/polygon vertex definitions, generic offsets/miter and exact sqrt(2) diamond default. Elementary endpoints retain shape semantics, not a retained material Tiptoe implementation.
replacement_constructions.rays_composite: Evenly spaced vector spokes and typed Rust composite accumulation through existing MarkSpec owners; explicit public phase and signed gaps retained.
replacement_constructions.transport_fitting: Existing Rust CBOR schemas, packed paths, Kurbo carrier/chord/refinement/stroke footprint owners preserved. They are not copied Tiptoe rendering/resource code.

retained_compatibility: Shape names, option vocabulary and dimensional default data retain the earlier Tiptoe-inspired public API. This is not a clean-room claim. Engineering source audit found no material Tiptoe package implementation/resource remaining in runtime geometry; old source/credits remain in immutable history and historical notes for independent review.
